criteria.requirement: Implement inflect.rules.define_nouns(engine,rules) using the completed independent engine clone. Each rule mapping has singular/plural and optional case, no unknown keys. Use real defnoun validation and precedence including regex/case policies; later valid rules override as normal. Validate and apply the entire iterable on a clone before committing any state to the original. Invalid pattern, case, rule shape or generator exception leaves all original state unchanged. Return accepted count and retain unrelated custom verbs/articles/options. Do not parse or execute rule text as Python.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
